full_judgment:
2. Petitioner Nasrin Akther claims that Respondent No. 3 being Pubali Bank Ltd. Khatungong Branch, under Police Station Kotwali, District-Chittagong, filed Artha Rin Suit No. 80 of 2010 and obtained a decree against the loanee Md Abu Nayeem being the proprietor of M/s Seagul Concern, (Respondent No. 4) and also against the petitioner and others. The decree was put to execution in Execution Case No. 21 of 2012 wherein the impugned auction notice was illegally published inviting tender for holding auction sale of Schedule-A property belonging to the loanee (Respondent No. 4) and also of Schedule-B property belonging to the petitioner. 

 3. Previously the decree holder Bank caused to be published a similar auction notice. So another judgment debtor filed in this Court Writ petition No. 8217 of 2011 which was disposed of by another Bench by judgment dated 18-10-2011 with a specific direction to the Artha Rin Adalat to the follow section 6(5) of the Artha Rain Adalat Ain 2003 (shortly the Ain, 2003). 

 5. Respondent No. 3 being the decree holder Bank has filed an affidavit-in-opposition and admitted the institution of the execution case and publication of the impugned auction notice containing the description of Schedule-A property belonging to the borrower and the Schedule-B property belonging to the petitioner. 

 8. In reply Mr Md Mamunur Rashid, the learned Advocate for the decree holder Bank (Respondent No. 3) submits that an order may be passed as stated in the paragraph-5 of the affidavit-in-opposition. 

 10. In such a situation 6(5) of the Ain, 2003 requires that the property mortgaged by the loanee is to be sold out first and if the decree is not satisfied then only the property mortgaged by trial party mortgagor can be auction sold. 

 14. The Adalat is further directed that if the sale proceeds of Schedule-A property is not sufficient to satisfy the decree, then the Adalat shall proceed to hold auction sale of Schedule-B property by way of publishing another fresh auction notice and shall dispose of the case in accordance with law.
